SEA-Stack — quick start (release package)
=========================================

Commands are shown for Windows first, then macOS/Linux. Run them from the
unzipped package root.

Main application:
  Windows:      bin\run_seastack.exe
  macOS/Linux:  ./bin/run_seastack

Example (from package root):
  Windows:      bin\run_seastack.exe demos\5sa\bimodal
  macOS/Linux:  ./bin/run_seastack demos/5sa/bimodal

Add --nogui to run without the 3D window.

External PTO demos (out-of-process Python modules; needs Python 3 on PATH):
  Windows:      bin\run_seastack.exe --nogui demos\rm3\external_pto
                bin\run_seastack.exe --nogui demos\oswec\external_pto
  macOS/Linux:  ./bin/run_seastack --nogui demos/rm3/external_pto
                ./bin/run_seastack --nogui demos/oswec/external_pto

  The demos launch `command: ["python", ...]`. On Windows this needs `python`
  on PATH; on macOS/Linux the host automatically falls back to `python3` when
  `python` is absent, so a stock Homebrew/apt Python 3 works unmodified. To
  force a specific interpreter, edit `command` in the case's
  *.external_pto.yaml (e.g. an absolute path to python).

  Sibling cases (same sea state; different module physics):
    demos/rm3/external_pto_adaptive    demos/rm3/external_pto_hydraulic
    demos/oswec/external_pto_adaptive  demos/oswec/external_pto_hydraulic

Comparison plots (same four figures as the source-tree verification workflow;
needs pip packages from tests/requirements.txt — several minutes, 4x ~600 s runs):
  Windows:      python examples\external_pto\run_visual_verification.py
                python examples\external_pto\run_visual_verification.py --platform oswec
  macOS/Linux:  python3 examples/external_pto/run_visual_verification.py
                python3 examples/external_pto/run_visual_verification.py --platform oswec

  Optional: --skip-run to replot existing demos/*/outputs, --open to launch the PDF.

Optional executables (if shipped in this build):
  standalone_controller  — small PTO/control example (no Chrono)
  demo_sphere_decay      — short C++ Chrono demo (when demos were enabled at build time)
  (bin\...exe on Windows; ./bin/... on macOS/Linux)

Verify install (needs Python 3.10+ and pip packages from tests/requirements.txt):
  Windows:      tests\RUN-TESTS.ps1
  macOS/Linux:  ./tests/RUN-TESTS.sh

Layout and outputs:
  See the SEA-Stack repository under docs/build/ (PACKAGE_LAYOUT.md, RUNTIME_OUTPUT.md).

macOS troubleshooting (packaged build diverges or NaNs while Windows passes):
  Compare this ZIP against a Release build from source on the same machine:
  use otool -L on bin/run_seastack and lib/*.dylib, confirm bundled libraries load
  (not mixed system copies), and check OpenMP/BLAS linkage. Release packaging
  verification after install: scripts/verify_release_install_prefix.py

Support (source builds):
  Windows:      scripts\windows\build.ps1 -Doctor
  macOS/Linux:  bash scripts/unix/build.sh --doctor
